front: You and your eidolon act as one: one of you uses an action or activity, the other takes a single action.
back:
Either you or your eidolon takes an action or activity costing the same number of actions as Act Together; the other takes 1 action.
Example with 2 actions: you cast breathe fire (2) and the eidolon Strikes (1), or the eidolon uses Dragon Breath (2) and you Stride (1).
Lets you each use separate exploration activities (like Avoid Notice) while traveling.
